issues.title: Production regression: extends relative path normalization
issues.summary: A service extending Compose config from a subdirectory builds against the wrong path and drops volume subdirectory context.
signals: builds fail only when the base service is imported from a sibling directory
Containerfile exists but generated build args point at a doubled path
bind mounts from extended service resolve relative to the root file instead of the source compose file
issues.acceptance: Recovery is complete when the affected behavior is fixed in /app/repo and the regression test passes.
